- Total revenue for TW was £25.2k, down 22.7% WoW from £32.6k in LW, and up 37.6% YoY against £18.3k in LY.
- Total units for TW were 7,456, down 17.3% WoW from 9,015 in LW, while TW orders of 390 were down 5.8% WoW.
- PAPER CHAIN KIT 50'S CHRISTMAS ranked 1 in TW with revenue of £5,701.16, a 22.6% share of TW total, despite falling 39.9% WoW.
- RABBIT NIGHT LIGHT delivered £5,084.81 in TW for a 20.2% share, down 52.4% WoW and the largest absolute decline at £5,602.88 below LW.
- CHILLI LIGHTS posted £4,960.25 in TW for a 19.7% share, up 115.0% WoW and the largest absolute gain at £2,653.24 above LW.
- CHILLI LIGHTS revenue was up 229.3% YoY versus the same ISO week in LY.
- REGENCY CAKESTAND 3 TIER revenue rose 17.3% WoW in TW.
- The top 3 products accounted for 62.4% of TW total revenue.
